'''Heiltsuk–Oowekyala''' is a [[Wakashan languages|Northern Wakashan]] (Kwakiutlan) language spoken in the [[British Columbia Coast|Central Coast]] region of the [[Canadian province]] of [[British Columbia]], spoken by the [[Wuikinuxv people|Wuikinuxv]] (Oweekeno) and [[Heiltsuk]] peoples. It has two dialects, [[Heiltsuk dialect|Heiltsuk]] (Bella Bella) and [[Oowekyala dialect|Oowekyala]] (Wuikyala), which unlike other Wakashan languages are [[tone (linguistics)|tonal]]. It has no traditional name, so the hyphenated construction Heiltsuk–Oowekyala is used by linguists. ''[[Ethnologue]]'' calls this language "Heiltsuk", with the Bella Bella dialect (Heiltsuk) labelled "Northern Heiltsuk" and the Oowekyala dialect labeled "Southern Heiltsuk".

Heiltsuk {{IPA|[ɦiɬtsʰaqʷ]}} is spoken by the Bella Bella {{IPA|[pʰəlbálá]}} and Haihais {{IPA|[xíxís]}} peoples; Oowekyala {{IPA|[ʔuwíkʼala]}} by the Wuikinuxv {{IPA|[ʔuwikʼinuxʷ]}}.

==Phonology==
{{Expand section|date=January 2025}}
Heiltsuk–Oowekyala, like [[Nuxálk language|Nuxalk]] (Bella Coola), allows long sequences of obstruents, as in the following 7-obstruent and 8-obstruent words from the Oowekyala variety:  {{lang|hei|c̓k̓ʷx̌tƛkc}} {{IPA|[t͡sʼkʷʼχtʰt͡ɬkʰt͡sʰ]}} 'the invisible one here-with-me will be short'{{sfn|Howe|2000|p=4}} or {{lang|hei|tpxʷpsƛkc}} 'the invisible one-here-with-me will be squeezed pleasantly'{{sfn|Howe|2000|p=11}} like the Nuxalk {{lang|blc|kxlqsłcxʷ}} 'you struck a match for me'.{{sfn|Howe|2000|p=11}}

==Writing system==
